description: Register an external SSL certificate issued by a third-party CA (e.g. Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, DigiCert). certificateName: 3-20 chars, starts with a letter, letters/digits/'-' only (validated before the call).

certificateName.description: Certificate name: 3-20 chars, must start with a letter, English letters/digits/'-' only, unique within the account (limit reduced from 30 to 20 chars on 2026-09-17)

privateKey.description: PEM-encoded private key (must be decrypted, not encrypted)

name: ncloud_register_external_certificate
